entity_name: North Lebanon Water Establishment - EELN (مؤسسة مياه لبنان الشمالي)

facts.value: Supply, distribution, and network maintenance of potable water, irrigation water, drainage, and sanitation for North Lebanon and Akkar governorates. Established under Law No. 221 dated 21/05/2000. Produces water through approximately 100 wells and 60 springs at an estimated 170,000 cubic meters (170 million liters) per day.
facts.notes: Confirmed from eeln.gov.lb/en/about/ on 2026-06-01. Also covers drainage, irrigation, and sanitation — not just potable water.

facts.value: NOT responsible for private building plumbing, internal water pipes, rooftop tanks, or building pumps. Responsible only for the public water supply network up to the building connection point.

Covers North Lebanon governorate and Akkar governorate — all districts: Tripoli, Koura, Zgharta-Ehden, Bsharri, Batroun, Minnieh-Dennieh, Akkar (Halba, Qobayat). Serves more than 110,000 families. Southern boundary: Madfoun area (Batroun/Jbeil boundary) — south of this is BMLWE territory. Does NOT cover Beirut, Mount Lebanon, Keserwan-Jbeil (→ BMLWE), South Lebanon/Nabatiyeh (→ SLWE), or Bekaa/Baalbek-Hermel (→ BWE).
facts.notes: Coverage confirmed from branch locations on eeln.gov.lb/en/contact/ on 2026-06-01. Batroun branch confirms Batroun district is NLWE, not BMLWE.

facts.value: Website: eeln.gov.lb. HQ address: Tripoli, Salahuddine Kabbara Street, Dam w Farz. HQ phone: 06/430 075. Email: comms@eeln.gov.lb. Working hours: Monday–Thursday 8:00AM–2:00PM only (Friday closed). Social media: Facebook, Instagram, YouTube. Online contact form at eeln.gov.lb/en/contact/ — fields: Name, Email, Phone, Message. Published response commitment: 24 hours.
facts.notes: All contacts verified from eeln.gov.lb/en/contact/ on 2026-06-01. Working hours are significantly shorter than BMLWE (8AM-2PM vs 8AM-4PM). Online contact form confirmed with Send Now button.

facts.value: Three complaint channels: (1) Call branch directly — use branch phone number matching complaint GPS location (see F005 for branch numbers by district). (2) Online contact form at eeln.gov.lb/en/contact/ — fields: Name, Email, Phone, Message. Published 24-hour response commitment. (3) Visit branch in person during working hours (Mon–Thu 8AM–2PM). No national hotline equivalent to BMLWE's 1713 — citizen must call the correct regional branch. For CedarFix: route by GPS → identify district → direct to relevant branch phone number.
facts.notes: No national hotline confirmed on eeln.gov.lb. Branch-level routing is the primary mechanism.

facts.value: Published response commitment: 'We respond to all messages within 24 hours' (from eeln.gov.lb/en/contact/). This applies to online contact form messages. No published SLA for physical infrastructure repair. CedarFix targets: supply interruption 24-48h; contamination — immediate HITL escalation.
facts.notes: 24-hour response is for contact form messages — confirmed directly from website on 2026-06-01. Physical repair SLA not published. Upgraded from low to medium confidence based on published commitment.

primary_for_sectors: WATER_supply — no water, supply interruption, low pressure (North Lebanon + Akkar)
WATER_pipe — burst pipe, water leak from public network
WATER_contamination — unsafe, discolored, or smelly water
WASTEWATER_overflow — sewage overflow, blocked public sewer
WATER_connection — new connection, illegal connection report
not_responsible_for: Private building plumbing or internal pipes — private contractor
Rooftop tanks or building pumps — private responsibility
Water issues in Beirut or Mount Lebanon — route to BMLWE
Water issues south of Madfoun/Jbeil boundary — route to BMLWE
Water issues in South Lebanon or Nabatiyeh — route to SLWE
Water issues in Bekaa or Baalbek-Hermel — route to BWE
hitl_conditions: Water contamination reports — always HITL, potential public health emergency
Sewage overflow into streets or public spaces — HITL, public health risk
GPS falls near BMLWE/NLWE boundary (Batroun/Jbeil-Madfoun area)
